description: This file defines enums and a variant related to F1AP cause codes used in 3GPP TS 38.473, including radio network causes, transport causes, and a union type for various cause categories. It also includes a formatter specialization for printing these cause types.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the formatter context, returns an iterator to the beginning of the context.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the ocudu::f1ap_cause_t variant into a string representation based on its active type.
